 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Beginer'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Beginner'.**
 
• The word '**Beginner**' is a **noun** which means 'a person who has just started to learn or do something'. **(शुरुआती)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• She is a beginner in playing the piano.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Beginer'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words -**

 
• **Prescription -** an instruction written by a medical practitioner that authorizes a patient to be issued a medicine or treatment **(पर्ची)**
 
• **Ceremony -** a formal religious or public occasion, typically one celebrating a particular event or anniversary **(समारोह)**
 
• **Disappointment -** sadness or displeasure caused by the non-fulfillment of one's hopes or expectations **(निराशा)**
